messages:
Nina R.: Heads up 1: CobaltCloud just dropped their brand kit and a short customer line for the case study. Need quick checks on logo lockups, color usage, and whether the quote needs vetting before marketplace publish. Files: https://files.redwood.ai/cobaltcloud/cobalt_brandkit_v1.zip
Marcus V.: downloading. first glance: primary mark uses #0A74FF which is close to our link blue. Recommend adding 24px clearspace on the right for balanced lockup with our wordmark. also ask for eps + svg outlines (no font outlines) for print export.
Priya S.: the quote is: "Redwood reduced our inference latency by 45% and cut costs." we should verify the 45% number or change to "improved inference latency by up to 45%" or "significantly improved inference latency". cc @LegalBot for approval flow on numeric claims.
LegalBot: Please request written approval from the customer retry: a signed quote approval form (we have a template). Numeric performance claims need source data or a statement like "based on CobaltCloud internal benchmarks". Also include correct trademark usage for CobaltCloud (capitalization + TM if needed).
DesignOps: made quick comps: `cobalt_redwood_lockup_A.svg` (icon left), `cobalt_redwood_lockup_B.svg` (stacked), and marketplace tiles in 1:1, 16:9, 4:1. Uploaded to assets bucket: https://assets.redwood.ai/cobaltcloud/comps.zip. I slightly darkened our wordmark to #0E3B66 to keep separation.
Nina R.: perfect. @Marcus V. can you finalize the lockups and export PNGs for marketplace sizes? @Priya S. please draft two softened quote options and the customer approval note using the legal template by EOD. I'll hold the marketplace publish until we have legal sign-off and the final SVGs. :white_check_mark:
